title: A mark anchored at its end at the origin is clipped by the axis edge
foundBy: repository owner, reading a consuming page: "the first dot is getting clipped?"
details:
The positioned axis keeps the halo padding, seven pixels at the default cell width, before the first position, and a mark size more after the last. A mark anchored at its end draws to the left of its position, so one at the origin reaches two pixels past the axis edge and its halo further. On a consuming page the first opening drew five of its nine pixels, measured in headless Chromium.

While any mark is anchored at its end, the axis should keep a mark size before the first position as well.
